decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's core coolant and fluid-handling expertise, so management can read early market feedback and improve the product with its own R&D, which favours keeping it.
The cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's coolant filtration knowledge base and remains listed through 2024, so the firm is well placed to assimilate customer feedback and refine it.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard, closely related line for a large machinery firm with deep chip-handling know-how, which gives it high absorptive capacity for continued development.

The hinged belt conveyor shares design and production knowledge with the scraper conveyor, and it has stayed on the website while the magnetic variant was dropped, which suggests the firm deliberately kept its core conveyor types.
